$comment: Per-agent local Ollama model specialization. Reviewed config change, not a UI knob. Every key under 'routes' is a REAL, confirmed agentType string from an actual AIRouter.routeTask('<agentType>', ...) call site (grepped across src/server before this file was written) - not an abstract domain label with no real code behind it. Applied at AIRouter.initialize() via setAgentRoute() as a DEFAULT, BEFORE persisted agent_routing_overrides load - a user's own routing choice from Settings still wins over this file. 'fallback' is a same-provider model retry (OpenAICompatibleProvider.ts), tried in order before AIRouter's own cross-provider failover takes over. researchTimeoutMs is the hard outer Abort/timeout cap for ALL agent inference (8s) so hung local models fail closed to HOLD without blocking the event loop.
notes: TechnicalAgent has no AI call to bind - it is deterministic real RSI/MACD/Bollinger math (CLAUDE.md), never calls AIRouter. Not listed here; do not fabricate a routing entry for it. There is no RULE_BASED fallback token to wire up here for the same reason - it is already 100% rule-based, always.

ChiefTraderAgent's consensus debate uses AIRouter.routeConsensus('ConsensusDebate', ...), which calls MULTIPLE providers in parallel to build a real weighted vote - it has no per-call model-override parameter the way routeTask() does, so a single model cannot be 'the' Chief Trader model without a deeper routeConsensus change not made in this pass. Not listed here. Consensus calls use researchTimeoutMs (not the generic tradingSafety.aiProviderTimeoutMs).

BullResearcher/BearResearcher (config/bullBearResearch.json) are real routeTask() call sites from ChiefTraderAgent's optional debate feature (QUANT_BULL_BEAR_ENABLED). Defaulted to Plutus (same class as FundamentalAgent) so they leave the HeavyModelMutex queue; ReflectionEngine alone keeps deepseek-r1:14b for post-trade post-mortem.
'ollama.baseUrl' mirrors config/networkEndpoints.json's aiLocal.ollamaDefault + '/v1' - kept as its own explicit field here (not re-derived) so this file stays a complete, standalone routing spec.

Every agent already fails closed on an AI failure independent of this file (HOLD/confidence 0, never a fabricated side) - see FundamentalAgent.ts/MacroAgent.ts's DATA_UNAVAILABLE path and RiskEngine's own deterministic gates, which never call an LLM at all.

NewsAgent.rationale: Fine-tuned on financial news/headlines/sentiment - real specialization match for NewsScoringEngine's sentiment+catalyst scoring.

FundamentalAgent.rationale: Fine-tuned on financial/economic/valuation texts - balance-sheet-style analysis matches FundamentalAgent's P/E, EPS growth, debt/equity prompt.

MacroAgent.rationale: Same model as FundamentalAgent - Plutus's training explicitly covers macroeconomic regime evaluation (yield curves, rate shifts), matching MacroAgent's CPI/Fed Funds/unemployment prompt.

ReflectionEngine.rationale: Deep chain-of-thought model for real post-trade post-mortem analysis on actual outcomes (ReflectionEngine.ts). Hard-capped at researchTimeoutMs so it cannot monopolize HeavyModelMutex.

BullResearcher.rationale: Adversarial debate role (config/bullBearResearch.json) - Plutus like FundamentalAgent so Bull/Bear leave the HeavyModelMutex queue shared with ReflectionEngine.

ExplainabilityAgent.rationale: Sub-second UI tooltip/explanation text generation - matches the 'fast telemetry/mobile explainer' domain exactly.
